title: CIS Synthetic Cloud Foundations Benchmark
description: Account-level settings for the Synthetic Cloud platform.

profile_definitions.title: Level 1
profile_definitions.description: Settings every account can take without changing how it is used.

profile_definitions.title: Level 2
profile_definitions.description: Settings for accounts holding sensitive data; they may cost more or need tools changed. Includes Level 1.

recommendations.title: Keep the account's security contact reachable

cis_controls.title: Keep a list of who to call in an incident

recommendations.description: The provider sends breach warnings and abuse complaints to the security contact on file.
recommendations.rationale: A warning that lands in an unread mailbox changes nothing.
recommendations.audit:
In the console:

1. Sign in with an administrator identity.
2. Go to **Settings** > **Who we contact**.
3. Check that the address and number reach a team rather than one person.

Or from a terminal:

```
synthcloud account contact show --account <account-number>
```
recommendations.remediation:
1. Go to **Settings** > **Who we contact** and choose **Change**.
2. Enter a shared team mailbox.

```
synthcloud account contact set --account <account-number> --mail <team-mailbox> --phone <team-number>
```

recommendations.title: Require a second sign-in factor for the account owner

cis_controls.title: Use a second factor for administrators

recommendations.description: The owner can do anything to the account, closing it included.
recommendations.rationale: If a password is all that protects it, one convincing phishing mail loses the account.
recommendations.impact: Losing the device means going through the provider's account recovery.
recommendations.remediation:
1. Sign in as the owner.
2. Under **Sign-in** > **Second factor**, register a security key.
3. Register a spare key and lock it away.

See [https://docs.example.com/synthetic-cloud/identity/second-factor](https://docs.example.com/synthetic-cloud/identity/second-factor).

recommendations.title: Replace programmatic credentials at least every 90 days

cis_controls.title: Give every account its own password

recommendations.description: Scripts and tools sign their calls with an API credential instead of a password.
recommendations.rationale: An old credential has had time to end up in scripts, laptops and chat logs.
recommendations.audit:
```
synthcloud credentials list --all-identities --older-than 90d --format table
```

The table is empty.
recommendations.remediation:
For each `<identity>` the audit lists:

```
synthcloud credentials issue --identity <identity>
synthcloud credentials retire --identity <identity> --credential <old-credential>
```

Move every tool to the new credential before retiring the old one.
recommendations.additional_info: Unused keys are better deleted than rotated.

recommendations.title: Grant no identity unrestricted permissions on everything
recommendations.description: A grant of `"do": "*"` on `"on": "*"` makes its holder an administrator of the whole account.
recommendations.rationale: Least privilege begins with nobody holding everything by default.
recommendations.impact: Identities that relied on the grant lose access until narrower grants replace it.
recommendations.audit:
```
synthcloud grants list --attached --format json
```

Look for an entry with `"effect": "allow"`, `"do": "*"` and `"on": "*"`.

recommendations.title: Reject bucket requests made without TLS

cis_controls.title: Encrypt sensitive data on the wire

recommendations.description: A bucket rule can turn away every request that did not arrive over TLS.
recommendations.rationale: Anyone on the path can read data sent in the clear.
recommendations.impact: Clients too old for TLS are refused.
recommendations.audit:
```
synthcloud bucket rules show --bucket <bucket>
```

One rule refuses requests when `"tls": false`.

recommendations.title: Keep earlier object versions in buckets
recommendations.description: With history on, a bucket keeps each object's earlier versions.
recommendations.rationale: An object that was overwritten or deleted by mistake can be restored.
recommendations.impact: Every version takes space. Add an expiry rule for old ones.

recommendations.title: Record API activity in every region
recommendations.description: The activity record lists every call made to the account's API.
recommendations.rationale: An attacker who finds a region nobody records can work there unnoticed.
recommendations.audit:
```
synthcloud activity recorders list --format table
```

One recorder shows `all regions: yes`.
recommendations.additional_info: A trail in each region costs more than one trail that records every region.

recommendations.title: Sign the activity record's log files
recommendations.description: Each hour the recorder can write a signed summary of the files it wrote.
recommendations.rationale: An altered or removed file then shows up when the summaries are checked.
recommendations.audit:
```
synthcloud activity recorders show --name <recorder> --field signed_summaries
yes
```

recommendations.title: Close SSH (port 22) to the whole internet
recommendations.description: A group rule that opens port 22 to `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0` invites SSH sign-in attempts from anywhere.
recommendations.rationale: Scanners find an open SSH port within minutes of an address coming up.
recommendations.impact: Administrators connect through a jump host or the provider's console sessions instead.
recommendations.audit:
```
synthcloud firewall rules list --port 22 --from-anywhere
```

The list is empty.
recommendations.additional_info: The same check applies to port 3389 (remote desktop); see 4.2 for the default group.
recommendations.default_value: A new group lets nothing in.

recommendations.title: Leave the default firewall group empty
recommendations.description: Resources created without a group are put in their network's default group.
recommendations.rationale: If the default group allows nothing, a forgotten resource is cut off rather than exposed.
recommendations.impact: Resources in the default group lose their connections until they get a group of their own.
recommendations.audit:
```
synthcloud firewall groups show --group default
```

The group has no rules in either direction.
recommendations.remediation:
1. Make a group for each resource that is in the default group.
2. Move each resource to its new group.
3. Delete every rule in the default group.

```
synthcloud firewall rules remove --group default --all
```
recommendations.default_value: Members may talk to each other freely.

recommendations.title: Accept only TLS 1.2 or newer on load balancers

cis_controls.title: Encrypt sensitive data on the wire

recommendations.description: Each listener has a profile that lists the TLS versions it will speak.
recommendations.rationale: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 have weaknesses that later versions fixed.
recommendations.impact: Very old clients can no longer connect.
